source_field_evidence.evidence: Specification section 5.1 instrumentation; section 6.1 N2 measured room air temperatures @110 cm
source_field_evidence.transform: floor-area-weighted mean of room-centre sensor temperatures
source_field_evidence.aggregation_identity: derived observation aggregate; not a direct measured volume-mean state or period-end temperature

source_field_evidence.evidence: Specification section 3.16: weather measured on site at minute intervals, provided 10-minute and hourly averages

source_field_evidence.transform: sum of room electrical heater channels divided by 1000
source_field_evidence.evidence: Specification sections 3.9, 5.1 and 6.1 N2 electric heating; nominal 2 kW heater measured 1.80-1.93 kW; actual workbook maxima 1790-1880 W for ordinary heated rooms
source_field_evidence.limit: Electricity input is measured. Unity conversion into room heat is model assumption; heater mass and radiative/convective dynamics are not independently represented.

source_field_evidence.raw_columns: available n2_aroom_{room}_IHS_elP channels only; no ventilation *_SUA_IHS_elP or calculated DHW
source_field_evidence.evidence: Specification section 6.1 N2: measured heater+IHS total split in some rooms according to scheduled IHS; their combined sum is used in RC
source_field_evidence.limit: The split between heating and IHS is publisher-calculated for single-heater rooms. Both parts are reunited in total_room_heat_input_kw, rather than claiming two independent meters.

source_field_evidence.evidence: Specification sections 3.16 and 5.1 on-site solar radiation

source_field_evidence.transform: maximum same-bin global and vertical facade irradiance divided by 1000
source_field_evidence.identity: declared effective irradiance proxy for bounded window gain, not measured transmitted solar heat

source_field_evidence.omitted: socket/fan heat, ventilation losses, attic/cellar storage and interroom exchange are not separately included

source_time_cet.evidence: Original N2 and weather workbook DATE; specification weather/data description

time_utc.transform: original workbook DATE minus 1 hour; winter fixed CET
time_utc.evidence: Original workbook DATE and explicitly recorded CET-to-UTC mapping

dt_hours.transform: 10 minutes / 60; all consecutive original timestamps checked
dt_hours.evidence: Original workbook DATE intervals; specification 3.16 / 6.1 ten-minute averages

observation_identity.evidence: field_evidence_map indoor-temperature aggregation and original room channels
